description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmbedImages' which handles embedding images in documentation pages by processing HTML tags, resolving image paths, and possibly replacing image sources via a callback.

classes.name: EmbedImages
classes.description: A class responsible for processing HTML content to embed images by resolving image URLs and optionally replacing them with embedded data or alternative sources.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EmbedImages class with a root tree object.

methods.name: embed
methods.description: Processes a page's HTML content, finds image tags, and replaces their sources using a callback function.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Extracts specific HTML attributes from an tag.

methods.name: findImage
methods.description: Attempts to resolve an image source to a file object, handling external URLs and local paths, and invokes a callback for embedding or processing.
